verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.sm: O LOO faapea ona fetalai mai oFi Ieova, Faauta, ou te faaosoina le'- matagi e faaumatia ai Papelonia, atoa foi ma i latou o e nonofo i totonu o e laga mai ia te au.

verses.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.sm: Ou te aauina atu i Papelonia o e faasavili saito, latou te faasaviligia o ia, ma matuā sasaaina atu lona nuu; auā latou te tau ma ia i ona itu uma i le aso o le malaia.

verses.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.sm: Ia lolo‘u le tagata fanafana u lana aufana, e fana atu ai i le ua lolo‘u mai lana aufana, ma le ua mitamita i lona ofutau uamea; aua foi ne‘i faasaoina ona taulelea ; ia matuā faaumatia ana ‘au uma lava.

verses.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.sm: E pauu foi e ua fasiotia i le nuu o Kaletaia, ma e ua tu‘ia ua ati e pauu i ona ala.

verses.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.sm: Auā e ui lava ina tumu lo latou nuu i le agasala i le Paia o 'Isaraelu, e le tuua Isaraelu, po o Iuta e lona Atua, o Ieova o ‘au.

verses.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.sm: Ina sosola ia outou ai totonu o Papelonia, ia taitasi ma faasaoina lona ola; aua ne‘i fano outou i lana agasala; auā o le tausaga lenei o le taui ma sui a Ieova ; na te taui atu ai ia te ia lona taui.

verses.en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.sm: O Papelonia o le ipu auro lea i le aao o Ieova, ua onā ai le lalolagi uma ; ua feinu nuu i lona uaina ; o le mea lea ua faavalea ai nuu.

verses.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.sm: Ua faafuasei ona paū o Papelonia, ua momomo ; ina uio ia outou ona o ia; ina avatu ia ni pulu pasama i lona tiga, atonu e malolo ai o ia.

verses.en: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.sm: Na tatou fofoina Papelonia, a e lei malolo ai o ia ; ina tatou tuua ia o ia ; ma taitasi ma alu i lona nuu; auā o lana sala ua pai atu i le lagi, ua maualuga e oo i ao.

verses.en: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
verses.sm: Ua faaalia e Ieova la tatou amiotonu ; ina o mai ia, se‘i tatou ta‘uta‘u atu i Siona le galuega a ieova lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.sm: Ina faapupulaina ia o u fanafana; ina faatumuina ia o talita ; ua faaosoina e Ieova loto o tupu o Metai; auā o lona finagalo e tau ma Papelonia, ia faaumatia ia; auā o le taui ma sui lenei a ieova, o le taui ma sui lava ona o lona malumalu.

verses.en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.sm: Ina sii ia i luga o le tagavai i pa o Papelonia, ia faamalosia le leoleoga, ia tofia tagata leoleo, ia tofia ‘au e tanu ; auā ua finagalo lava Ieova, ma na faia le mea na ia fetalai mai ai i e o nonofo i Papelonia.

verses.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.sm: O oe na le mau i le vai tele, ua tamaoaiga i oloa, ua oo mai lou iuga, le fua o lou matapeapea.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.sm: Ua tauto Ieova o ‘au ia te ia lava, ua faapea, E moni, ou te faatumuina oe i tagata, e pei o le se aleka; e pa foi la latou alaga ia te oe.

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.sm: Na faia e ia le lalolagi i lona mana, na faatumauina e ia le atu laulau i lona poto, na fofolaina foi e ia o le lagi i lona faautauta.

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.sm: Ua tūlei mai lona siufofoga, ona tele ai lea o le vai i le lagi; e avae foi e ia o le ausa mai tuluiga o le lalolagi; e faia e ia le uila atoa ma le ua, e aumaia foi e ia le matagi mai ana mea e teu ai oloa.

verses.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.sm: Ua taitasi ma valea tagata uma e leai so latou poto ; ua taitasi ma faamaina foi tufuga fai mea uamea? ona o le tupua ua ta; auā o le mea pepelo lana tupua uamea, e leai foi se mānava ia te i latou.

verses.en: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.sm: E faatauvaa ia mea, o le galuega e tauemua ; e fano lava i latou i ona po e tauia ai i latou.

verses.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.sm: E le pei o ia mea le tofi o Iakopo ; auā o ia lava na faia mea uma ; o Isaraelu foi o le tootoo o lona tofi lea ; o Ieova o ‘au, o lona suafa lea.

w.en: which is the of his inheritance,
which is the is his name.

verses.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.sm: O oe o la‘u uatogi, o le auupega o le taua; o oe ua ou tu‘imomomoina ai nuu; o oe foi ua ou faaumatia ai malo ;

verses.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.sm: o oe foi ua ou tufimomomoina ai le solofanua ma le tietie ai; o oe foi ua ou tufimomomoina ai le kariota ma le tietie ai;

verses.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.sm: o oe foi ua ou tu‘imomomoina ai le tane ma le fafine ; o oe foi ua ou tu‘imomomoina ai le toeaina ma le tama itiiti; o oe foi ua ou tufimomomoina ai le taulealea ma le taupou ;

verses.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.sm: o oe foi ua ou tufimomomoina ai le leoleo mamoe ma lana lafu; o oe foi ua ou tufimomomoina ai le tagata galue fanua ma ana povi e lua; o oe foi ua ou tu‘imomomoina ai ta‘ita‘i ma faipule.

verses.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua ou tauia foi i Papelonia, ma i latou uma o e nonofo i Kaletaia, la, latou amio leaga uma ua latou faia i Siona i o outou luma, ua fetalai mai ai ieova.

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te faia oe mo‘u fili, o loo fetalai mai ai Ieova, o oe na le mauga na te faaumatia; o le faaumatiaai le lalolagi uma; ou te faaloaloa lo‘u lima i luga ia te oe, ma ou fuli ifo ia te oe mai papa, ma ou faia oe ma mauga ua mu.

verses.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Latou te le avea se maa ia te oe e fai ma tulimanu, po o se maa e fai ma faavae; auā e fai oe ma faatafunaga e faavavau, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.sm: Ia outou sii i luga le tagavai i le lalolagi, ia ilia le pu i nuu, ia outou sauniuni nuu e tau ma ia, ia faalaei‘au i malo o Ararata, ma Meni, ma Asekeneso e tau ma ia; ma ia tofia alii e pule i ‘au e tau ma ia; ia o ae foi solofanua e pei o le se aleka taufulufulu.

verses.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.sm: Ia sauniuni nuu e tau ma ia, o tupu o Metai, ma ona ta‘ita‘i, ma ona faipule uma, ma le nuu uma ua ia pule i ai.

verses.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.sm: E gatete le laueleele ma le tiga; auā e tumau le pule a Ieova i Papelonia, e fai le nuu o Papelonia ma faatafunaga, e leai se nofo ai.

verses.en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.sm: Ua tuua le taua e toa o Papelonia, ua latou nonofo i colo; ua mavae lo latou malosi; ua avea i latou ua ni fafine; ua susunuina ana mea e mau ai; ua gauia ona faamau faalava.

verses.en: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
verses.sm: E momo‘e le tagata tele vave e faafetaiai i le tagata tele vave, o le ave feau foi e faafetaiai i le ave feau, e ta‘u atu i le tupu o Papelonia ua matuā aea lana aai;

verses.en: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.sm: ua maua foi ala, ua faamuina u i le afi, ua atuatuvale tagata tau.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.sm: Auā o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, O le tama fafine a Papelonia e pei o le mea e soli ai saito o ia i ona po e solia ai; e toe itiiti ane, ona oo ai lea i ona po e selesele ai ia te ia.

verses.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.sm: Ua ‘aina a‘u, ua faaumatia e Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, ua faia a‘u e ia ma ipu e. le io, ua na foloina a‘u e pei o le tanimo, ua na faatumuina lona manava i a‘u mea faafiafia; ua na tulia lava a‘u.

verses.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.sm: E fai ane le ua nofo i Siona, O le sauaina o a‘u ma lo‘u tino ia i luga o Papelonia lea; e fai ane foi Ierusalema, la i luga o e nonofo i Kaletaia lo‘u toto.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o ieova, Faauta, ou te faia lau finauga, ou te matuā taui foi ma sui ona o oe ; ou te faamateina lona vai, ma faamatutuina lona vaipuna.

verses.en: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.sm: E fai foi Papelonia ma faupuega maa, o le mea e fale ai luko, o le mea foi e ofo ai, ma uisa ai, e leai foi se nofo ai.

verses.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
verses.sm: Latou te fetagisi faatasi e pei o leona taanoa, latou te leo tetele foi e pei o tamai leona.

verses.en: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te saunia a latou tausamiga a o vevela i latou, ou te faainu foi ia te i latou ia onā, ina ia latou olioli, ma momoe i le moe e faavavau, ma latou le ala mai, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.sm: Ou te aveina ifo i latou e pei o tamai mamoe ia fasia, e pei o mamoe poa foi ma ‘oti poa.

verses.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.sm: E! ua aea Sesaka; ua maua le na viia e le lalolagi uma. E! ua, avea Papelonia ma mea e ofo ai nuu.

verses.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.sm: Ua alu ae le vai i luga o Papelonia; ua ufitia o ia i le tele o ona peau.

verses.en: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.sm: Ua fai ona aai ma faatafunaga, o le fanua naumati, ma le lafulafua; o le nuu e leai se tagata e nofo ai, e le ui ane ai foi se atalii o se tagata.

verses.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.sm: Ou te taui atu ia Pele i Papelonia; ou te to ae i lona gutu le mea na ia foloina; e le toe gasolo atu foi ia te ia o nuu; e solo i lalo foi le pa o Papelonia.

verses.en: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.sm: Lo‘u nuu e, ina o ese atu ia i totonu ia te ia, ma ia taitasi ma faasaoina lona ola ai le toasa tele o Ieova.

verses.en: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.sm: Aua ne‘i faavaivai o outou loto, aua ne‘i outou fefefe i le tala e lagona i le nuu; auā e sau le tala i lea tausaga, e mulimuli ane foi le tala i le tasi tausaga, e i ai foi le saua i le nuu, e tauva lea faipule ma lea faipule.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, e oo mai ai ona po ou te taui atu ai i tupua ua ta a Papelonia; e faamaina lona nuu uma ; e pauu foi i totonu ia te ia ona tagata uma ua fasiotia.

verses.en: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona alalaga fiafia ai lea o le lagi, ma le lalolagi, ma mea uma ua i ai, ona o Papelonia; auā e o mai ia te ia tagata faatafuna mai le itu i matu, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.sm: E paū lava Papelonia, outou tagata o Isaraelu ua fasia; e pauu foi faatasi ma Papelonia o tagata ua fasia i nuu uma lava.

verses.en: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.sm: O outou ua sao i le pelu, ina o ia outou, aua le tutū ; ia outou manatua Ieova ai le nuu mamao, ia outou manatunatu foi i Ierusalema.

verses.en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD'S house.
verses.sm: Ua faamaina i matou, auā ua matou faalogo i le luma ; ua ufitia o matou tama i le masiasi; auā ua ulu atu tagata ese i mea paia i le fale o ieova.

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, e oo mai ai ona po, ua fetalai mai ieova, ou te taui atu ai i ona tupua ua ta; e feoi foi tagata manunua i lona nuu uma.

verses.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E ui lava ina alu ae o Papelonia i le lagi, e ui lava ina teua foi e ia le ‘olo i le mea maualuga e malosi ai o ia, a e o atu mai ia te au o e faatafuna ia te ia, ua fetalai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.sm: O le leo o le alaga mai Papelonia, ma le olopalaina tele mai le nuu o Kaletaia;

verses.en: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.sm: auā ua faatafunaina Papelonia e Ieova, ma ua faaumatia e ia le leo tele nai ia te ia; ua taalili mai ona galu e pei o le vai e tele, ua vagana mai o latou leo ;

verses.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.sm: auā ua oo ia te ia, o Papelonia lava, o le na te faatafunaina; ua puea ona tagata totoa, ua gauia a latou aufana; auā o Ieova le Atua o ia e taui atu, e matuā taui atu e ia.

verses.en: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.sm: Ou te faainu ia onā ona alii, ma ona tagata popoto, ma ona ta‘ita‘i, ma ona faipule, ma ona toa; latou te momoe i Ie moe e faavavau, ma latou le ala mai, ua fetalai mai ai le Tupu, o ieova o ‘au, o lona suafa lea.

w.en: which is the is his name.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova o ‘au, E matuā sōloia i lalo pa o Papelonia lautele e susunuina i le afi ona puipui maualuluga; o nuu e galulue fua i latou, o tagata foi e galulue ma le afi, ma lailoa i latou.

verses.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.sm: O le upu na fai atu ai Ieremia le perofeta ia Seraia le atalii o Neria, le atalii o Maaseia, ina ua alu atu o ia faatasi ma Setekaia le tupu o Iuta i Papelonia, i le fa o tausaga o lana nofoaiga. O Seraia foi o le alii filemu ia.

verses.en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.sm: Na tusia e leremia i le tusi e tasi o le malaia uma o le a oo i Papelonia, o ia upu uma ua tusia ia Papelonia.

verses.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Ieremia ia Seraia, A e oo i Papelonia, ma e vaai, ma faitau i nei upu uma,

verses.en: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.sm: ona e fai atu ai lea, Ieova e, ua e fetalai rnai i lenei mea ina ia faaumatia, ina ia leai se nofo ai, o se tagata po o se manu, a e fai ia ma faatafunaga e faavavau.

verses.en: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.sm: A uma foi ona e faitauina o lenei tusi, ia e nonoa ai se maa, ma lafoina i totonu o Eufirate;

verses.en: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.sm: e te fai atu foi, E faapea ona goto o Papelonia, ma le toe ea i le malaia ou te faaoo ai i ona luga; e lailoa foi i latou. Ona gata lea o upu a Ieremia. O le malaia na oo ia Setekaia le tupu
